artworks.title: Saint Peter and Saint Paul at the Door of Bonhomme Misere (Saint Pierre et Saint Paula la port du Bonhomme Misere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing closely together in what appears to be the entrance of a building. The man on the left is facing forward, but angled slightly towards the viewer, while the other two are turned to the side facing him. The man on the left has an elderly appearance with a long beard and is wearing a robe. The middle figure is wearing a cloth head covering and has short, smooth hair visible under the headpiece. The figure on the right also appears elderly with a full beard and hair. His robe is draped over his shoulders, and he seems to gesture with his hands beneath the fabric. Behind the figures, there is a ladder leaning against the wall, and shading that suggests a roof or overhang above them. A tree branch extends from the top right corner of the background.

artworks.title: Supper of the Poor (Le souper chez misere)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows four people sitting around a table. They are seated closely together, with their upper bodies visible. The people have distinctive facial features, and one has a beard. The group is illuminated by a central light source, possibly a candle on the table, casting shadows on their faces and hands. They are wearing simple, casual clothing with no visible accessories. One person is wearing a hat. The table is sparsely laid out with a few items. In the background, there is a wall and an object resembling a cluster of lights hanging above. The drawing style adds to the scene's atmosphere.

artworks.title: Encounter of the Moorish Horsemen (Rencontre de Cavaliers Maures)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two horses rearing up and facing each other. The drawing captures a dynamic scene featuring two horses mid-action. Their bodies are intertwined as they rear. The horse on the left is lighter in tone, while the horse on the right is darker. The drawing features fine lines and detailed shading, contributing to the depiction of the musculature and motion of the animals. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: Gellius de Bouma
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated in a chair, positioned slightly turned to the side. He has one hand resting on his lap and the other holding a piece of fabric. His facial features include a white beard and mustache, heavy eyelids, and a gentle expression. He wears a cap and a long coat with detailed buttons, along with a pleated ruff around his neck. The background includes a table with papers, an inkwell, and a quill. The backdrop is dark and textured, creating depth to the portrait. No jewelry is visible, and the setting suggests a scholarly or stately environment.

artworks.title: Dance in the Country (La danse à la campagne)
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman dancing closely together outdoors. The woman has her arm around the man's shoulder, leaning towards him with her eyes closed. She has long hair with flowers or ribbons and wears a flowing dress with decorative elements. The man holds her waist with one arm and their other hands are clasped. He wears a striped jacket and a hat that partially covers his face, revealing a bit of beard on his chin. The background features sketchy, textured vegetation.

artworks.title: Robert Abbot, Bishop of Salisbury
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a half-length portrait of a man seated, holding an open book in his left hand. He has a long beard and mustache, wearing a distinct cap and robe typical of the Renaissance or early Baroque period. The background is plain with fine cross-hatching, and there are vertical studs on the chair. Engraved text identifies him as Robertus Abbatvs Epis: Sarum.

artworks.title: Domini Robertus, Episcopi Salisbury (Robert Abbot, Bishop of Salisbury)
artworks.description: This image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. The individual is seated or positioned slightly forward and gazes directly at the viewer. He has a long beard and mustache, with sharp and distinct facial features. His hair is covered by a cap. The man is wearing a voluminous garment with a large collar and puffed sleeves. He holds a pair of spectacles or pince-nez in his hands, and before him is an open book. The background is decorated with ornate scrollwork and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Johann Adam Renner of Allmendingen
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is facing forward in a seated position, with his gaze directed slightly off to the side. The man has a round face with a prominent nose, a short beard, and a mustache. His hair is covered by a cap, snugly fitting over his head. He is dressed in traditional clerical clothing with a high, white collar and a dark, intricately designed garment with visible buttons. In front of him is a large coat of arms protected by a bishop's mitre, featuring detailed heraldic symbols. The background is an ornate, engraved frame with Latin text surrounding the portrait, and decorative elements including cherubs, swirls, and classical figures.

artworks.title: Joannes Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the mid-chest upwards. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has curly, short hair and a neatly shaped beard and mustache. He is wearing detailed clothing, featuring a high-collared shirt with lace and a jacket with decorated epaulettes. He is not visibly wearing any jewelry or holding any objects. The background consists of engraved lines, adding depth to the portrait, and the entire composition is encased within an oval with a Latin inscription encircling it.

artworks.title: Godfrey Adelmar, Founder of the Knights Templar
artworks.description: The man is in a suit of armor with a helmet, pauldrons, gauntlets, and greaves. He has a mustache, a sharp jawline, and holds a sword in his right hand. He stands in front of an arched architectural frame with a checkered floor. In the background, there is a castle under siege with smoke and fire, along with hills and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Albert of Austria, Archduke
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man in an oval frame. He is facing forward, with his head slightly turned to his left. The man has a beard and mustache, short, wavy hair, and a serious expression, looking outward. He is dressed in elaborate armor with a large collar around his neck and a sash across his torso. Two cherubic figures holding laurel wreaths are positioned at the upper corners of the frame. Below the portrait is another oval with a scene depicting two female figures, a spear, and a cityscape. The background features scrollwork and Latin text.

artworks.title: Albert, Archduke of Austria
artworks.artist: Jan Muller after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man seated, facing slightly left. He has a slender face with defined cheekbones and a prominent mustache. He has short, combed-back hair and wears an elaborate outfit with a large ruff, fur trimmings on his sleeves, and a patterned cloak. He holds a sword or dagger in his left hand. In the background, there is a table with ornate cloth and a vase with flowers. Other background details include textured horizontal bands resembling wooden paneling or abstract lines. The bottom of the image has a section of Latin text.

artworks.title: Albert of Austria, Archduke
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait showing the upper body of a man in a central ornate circular frame. The man is depicted facing forward with a slight turn of his head to the left, displaying a distinguished expression. He has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, short styled hair, and wears a detailed garment with a high collar, intricate patterns, fur trim, and a regal appearance. Two cherubs with wings hold the circular frame, topped with a laurel wreath. Below the portrait, there is an oval inset of an illustrative scene with two figures in a landscape, surrounded by decorative scrollwork. Underneath, there is a block of text in two columns resembling an inscription, set against a backdrop of engraved lines.

artworks.title: Albert VII, Archduke of Austria
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a detailed portrait within an ornate oval border. The man faces slightly to the right with a calm expression. He has a mustache and a beard, with a serious demeanor. He wears a dark coat with a high collar and a large, decorative hat. The frame around him is adorned with inscriptions and artistic depictions of cherubic figures carrying symbols. The background is intricate and decorative, emphasizing the central portrait in a formal and historical context.

artworks.title: Albert VII, Archduke of Austria
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode II after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image depicts a man shown from the waist up. He is slightly turned to his right, looking directly at the viewer. He has a nose, beard, mustache, and neatly combed back hair. He wears a fur-trimmed cloak, a ruffled collar, and a chain with a medallion around his neck. His right hand rests on a cane or scepter held vertically. Adjacent to him on a table draped with cloth, there is an ornate crown. The background consists of a rectangular border with hatched lines. An inscription in Latin is at the bottom of the etching.

artworks.title: Albert VII, Archduke of Austria
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a portrait of a man in historic clothing with an ornate hat and ruffled high collar. His facial features include a mustache and beard, styled hair, and he is looking towards his right shoulder. There is an oval frame surrounding the portrait with floral motifs and vases on either side. Text is present within the frame and below the illustration.

artworks.title: Archduke Albert and Isabella Clara Eugenie of Austria
artworks.description: The engraving shows two full-length figures standing side by side. The man on the left has one hand on his hip and the other resting on a sword. He wears an elaborate feathered hat, a detailed doublet, a pleated skirt-like armor piece, and leg armor. Next to him is a depiction of a helmet and gauntlets on the ground. The woman on the right stands with her body slightly turned towards the man, holding her cloak. She has a high, styled hairstyle and a large ruffled collar. Her gown is decorated with intricate patterns and embroidery, with long sleeves and ornate cuffs. She wears a pendant around her neck. Both individuals stand against a backdrop of draped fabric, with coats of arms displayed above each person.

artworks.title: Jeanne D'Albret, Queen of Navarre, Mother of Henry IV of France
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait featuring the upper body of a woman within an oval frame. She is facing forward, with her head slightly tilted to her right. Her facial features are sharply defined with a high forehead, arched eyebrows, large eyes, a straight nose, and a closed mouth. Her hair is styled back, with a decorative headpiece. She is adorned in an elaborate gown with a high collar, puffed sleeves, and pearl accents. Surrounding her is an ornate oval border containing text identifying her as Jeanne d'Albret, mother of Henry IV, king of France and Navarre. The background within the frame is shaded with lines, and below it is a panel with engraved text in French.

artworks.title: Jeanne D'Albret, Queen of Navarre and Mother of Henry IV of France
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, looking to her right. She wears a dress with puffed sleeves, intricate ruffles, and a high neckline. Her hair is styled and held back with a headpiece. She wears a necklace and holds a string of beads or pearls. She sits in front of rich drapery with fringes. On a surface before her is a piece of paper and a small open compartment. Text at the bottom describes her identity.

artworks.title: Jeanne d'Albret, Queen of Navarre, Mother of Henry IV of France
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter view portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is facing slightly to the side with a composed expression. The portrait details her facial features, including a narrow face, high forehead, arched eyebrows, and a small smile. Her hair is styled elaborately, with a partial bun adorned with a decorative cap. The woman wears an intricate gown with ruffled collar and padded shoulders, embellished with patterns, and accessorized with a pearl necklace and a bracelet. One hand is against her midriff, appearing to hold a folded fan. The background includes a decorative frame with text identifying her as Jeanne D'Albret and a cartouche with French text.

artworks.title: Andrea Alciati
artworks.description: The image displays an upper body depiction of a man facing slightly to his left within an oval frame. He has a full beard and mustache, wavy hair under a flat cap. He appears neutral, looking slightly to the right. The man wears a textured garment with a fur collar, holding a small book in his left hand, with his right hand nearby. The background has an intricate pattern forming the oval frame embellished with detailed artistic elements resembling decorative patterns or foliage. The name "ANDRÉ ALCIAT" is shown beneath the image.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait of a man's head and shoulders. He is positioned facing slightly to the left but looking towards the viewer. His facial features include prominent cheekbones and a bushy mustache and beard, with the hair on his head partially covered by a cap. His hair is medium in length and seems to be wavy or curly. The man wears a cloak or robe with intricate patterns, and underneath is a garment with finely gathered fabric at the neck. Around his neck is an ornate necklace. The background consists of fine lines creating a textured effect. At the bottom, there are inscriptions in Latin.

artworks.title: Henry Aldrich, Dean of Christ Church
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing slightly to the left and has long, wavy hair. His facial features include a prominent nose and a serious expression. He is wearing a traditional clerical robe with a white clerical collar. The background has a gradient shading in an oval shape. The portrait includes text at the bottom identifying the subject as Henricus Aldrich.

artworks.title: Godfredus Aldemarus Alexandrino (Godfrey Adelmar)
artworks.description: The image shows a man wearing full armor and a helmet with a cross-like design on the chest plate. He has a mustache and is holding a sword in his right hand, with the left hand on his hip. The detailed armor features jointed plates and rivets. The man is standing on a patterned floor within an arched architectural frame. The background includes a scene with rolling hills, clouds in the sky, and distant buildings with smoke rising.
